front: How many chapters does the 2013 Constitution have?

back: The Constitution is the highest law; any law, custom or conduct inconsistent with it is invalid to that extent (section 2).

front: Name four founding values in section 3.
back: Any four of: supremacy of the Constitution, rule of law, human rights and freedoms, dignity, equality, gender equality, good governance, recognition of the liberation struggle.

front: What are the three tiers of government?
back: National government; provincial and metropolitan councils; local authorities.
Transfer of some powers and responsibilities from national government to provincial and metropolitan councils and local authorities.
Chapter 2: national objectives. Chapter 3: citizenship. Chapter 4: Declaration of Rights.

front: Which chapter deals with independent commissions supporting democracy?

back: Dividing government power among the Executive, Legislature and Judiciary so that each checks the others.
It is the supreme law, protects rights, sets up and limits government, unites the nation and guides policy.
